mechanism_narrative: A stable or declining federal funds rate indicates accommodative monetary policy, which lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is stable or declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.8% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals reduced liquidity, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
